title: When the Lantern Burns
author: Yara Lockridge
blurb: Petra Whitlock, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
